bio.text: Paul LePage is the Republican nominee for Maine's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served as Governor of Maine from 2011 to 2019 and as mayor of Waterville from 2004 to 2011, after two terms on the Waterville City Council.
LePage was born in Lewiston, Maine, and holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Husson University and an MBA from the University of Maine.
He worked as a business executive, consultant and advisor before entering politics.
